INSERT INTO report_checklist_items ( report_checklist_id, checklist_item_id, is_checked )
SELECT #{reportChecklistId}, ci.checklist_item_id,
CASE WHEN arcr.is_verified = TRUE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
FROM checklist_items ci
LEFT JOIN analysis_report_checklist_results arcr ON arcr.analysis_report_id = #{analysisReportId} AND arcr.checklist_item_id = ci.checklist_item_id
WHERE ci.category = 'COMMON' OR ci.category = #{category}
OR ci.category = 'TRUST_PROPERTY'
mapper.select:
SELECT ar.analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, rc.report_checklist_id AS reportChecklistId, ar.housing_category AS housingCategory, ar.is_trust_property AS trustProperty,
CASE WHEN rc.report_checklist_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS checklistCreated,
ar.created_at AS reportCreatedAt
FROM analysis_reports ar
LEFT JOIN report_checklists rc ON rc.analysis_report_id = ar.analysis_report_id
WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId}
ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC, ar.analysis_report_id DESC

SELECT ci.checklist_item_id AS checklistItemId, ci.contents, ci.category, rci.is_checked AS checked
FROM report_checklist_items rci
INNER JOIN report_checklists rc ON rc.report_checklist_id = rci.report_checklist_id
INNER JOIN checklist_items ci ON ci.checklist_item_id = rci.checklist_item_id
WHERE rc.report_checklist_id = #{reportChecklistId}
AND rc.account_id = #{accountId}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ci.category = 'COMMON' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ci.checklist_item_id ASC
